english.note: College accepts TOEFL iBT, IELTS, PTE or DET, valid two years; Biology-specific thresholds not established. Degree earned or in progress at US institution or institution where English is sole medium can satisfy proof. documents: Readable unofficial PDF transcripts from every institution; final official degree records and certified English translations when applicable

requirements.note: College baseline: accredited bachelor or equivalent (also accepts qualifying master/first professional degree). Biology GRE General not required. No Biology-specific GPA or prerequisite threshold established in opened current instructions.

funding.note: Connected Science Biology program states full tuition scholarship, stipend-bearing graduate assistant position and health insurance for program duration. No current amount or separately explicit international funding scope established; confirm written offer and remaining fees.
